Hiring managers won’t tell you the truth, but I will. As an ex-Google recruiter & hiring manager who built out my own teams, I’ve sat in the hiring rooms at Google, Lyft, TikTok, and The New York Times, and I know what’s actually being discussed when decisions get made.

In this video, I reveal 6 secrets hiring managers don’t say out loud: why some interviews are just for “show,” why being the runner-up can land you a stronger offer, and how bias, fear, and risk-aversion shape every step of the process.

If you’ve ever left an interview confused about what really happened, this will give you the behind-the-scenes reality.
